en-US.name: Spoken Letter
en-US.summary: Play the family stories delivered to your Spoken Letter account on your Echo.
en-US.description: Spoken Letter brings your family's stories to your Echo. Ask for the newest story, a story from your favorite storyteller, or the next one. Start a story draft, save a wish for a new story, share what you liked or loved, and catch up on your updates. Choose a listener, finish your story, and manage credits in the Spoken Letter app. Turn on notifications to know when you have an update, then open Spoken Letter to hear it.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask spoken letter to play the story Aunt Whitney sent
Alexa, ask spoken letter what is new

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Development stage. Say: open spoken letter; play the story Aunt Whitney sent; what is new; next; start over; shuffle on; pause; resume; let's create a story; about mermaids; read my draft; I want a story about mermaids; how do I add credits. Playback uses fixture recordings. Drafts are saved only for the demo and are not delivered. Fixture wishes, reactions, and updates remain in the demo inbox. On the Owner's opted-in test device, a separately authorized development notification uses Amazon's generic MessageAlert wording; open the skill to hear fixture detail.
